name: Parity Seal
description: Set the foe's qi against its own exact mirror until it is sealed and still.

name: Dampen Pulse
description: Send a pulse of opposed qi that dampens the force of an incoming technique to nothing.

name: Stillness Rinse
description: Wash an ally in quiet level qi to clear poison and the backlash of a qi deviation.

name: Restful Touch
description: Rest both palms on an ally and bring his strained body down to a deep even rest.

name: Annulling Wave
description: Cast a wide wave tuned to the foes' techniques that cancels each and presses their bearers down.

name: Leveling Strike
description: Strike with the weight of the whole field to level a towering foe to the ground.

name: Ballast Mantle
description: Weigh down the allies' stance with a mantle of ballast that shields them and steadies their power.

name: Calm Revival
description: Bring back a person whose breath has just stopped by settling heart and breath to one calm rhythm.

name: Equilibrium Shatter
description: Break the foe's balance at its root so that the full harm he has dealt falls on him through any guard.

name: Void Poise
description: Draw the surging force of the battle into the body and give it back as mending to the hurt.

name: Null Point
description: Slip into the point where all forces cancel and pass through a strike or a ward unharmed.

name: Peace Verdict
description: The school's closing move that rules all hostile force in the field void with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Great Leveling
description: Level every height of power on a wide field to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Utter Stillness
description: Cancel all force on a wide land at the moment of its release to the ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Tare Seal
description: Subtract the weight of the foe's technique from the field until it has none left to use.

name: Unwind Wave
description: Unwind an oncoming blast with a wave of opposed spin that leaves only a breeze.

name: Settling Rinse
description: Settle the stirred and soiled qi of an ally and rinse out the curse that unbalanced it.

name: Evening Salve
description: Work a slow even salve of qi into an ally's wounds until they ease and knit.

name: Counterweight Surge
description: Surge forward with a counterweight to a strike and return its force in a blow of equal weight.

name: Cancelling Tide
description: Send a tide of opposed qi across the field that cancels the techniques it meets.

name: Harmonic Mantle
description: Raise a mantle of harmony over the allies that evens their power and turns heavy blows.

name: Restoring Hush
description: Spread a deep hush over the field that mends the allies and stills the foes' frenzy.

name: Weighed Return
description: Return a mighty strike to its maker with the exact force and weight it carried through all guards.

name: Stillness Phase
description: Pass into a moment of perfect stillness and move through a barrier before it is felt.

name: Surplus Draw
description: Draw the excess force of the field into the body and share it out evenly among the allies.

name: Unity Verdict
description: The school's judging move that brings every force in the field to one level with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Peace Edict
description: The school's gentle move that voids hostile force round the user and mends the allies with a weight that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Cosmic Parity
description: Set every force on a wide land at parity and press the whole of it to the ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Grand Equalization
description: Equalize all that stands on a vast field with a ruin that reaches the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.
